strings.zh: 你的手机还没有收音机卡吗？{NEWLINE}如果装上收音机卡的话,{CLEAR}就能听到很多有趣的节目了。{SCROLL}听说枯叶码头附近就有人{NEWLINE}有收音机卡哦。

strings.en: Saffron sure is a big city. Besides the{NEWLINE}official Gym set up by the{CLEAR}Pokémon League, there’s also a private{CLEAR}martial arts hall, the Hunyuan Dojo. Two{CLEAR}Gyms in one city is really rare in{CLEAR}any region.

strings.zh: 我一直都想给我的精灵{NEWLINE}买些提升努力值的补剂,{CLEAR}但是这些产品现在{CLEAR}都被西鲁夫公司掌控着,{CLEAR}他们把价格定的太贵了。{SCROLL}希望这次精灵联盟{NEWLINE}对西鲁夫公司的改革方案落地后,{CLEAR}能让这些补剂便宜一点吧！
strings.en: I’ve always wanted to buy my Pokémon{NEWLINE}some EV-boosting supplements, but Silph{CLEAR}Co. controls them all now, and they’ve{CLEAR}set the prices way too high.{SCROLL}I hope the Pokémon League’s{NEWLINE}reform plan for Silph Co.{CLEAR}brings these supplements down{CLEAR}in price once it goes through!

strings.zh: 看来精灵联盟的改革真的有效呢,{NEWLINE}现在西鲁夫公司{CLEAR}已经不像原来那样只顾着赚钱了,{CLEAR}各种产品的价格都变得亲民了。
strings.en: Looks like the Pokémon League’s{NEWLINE}reforms really worked. Silph Co. isn’t{CLEAR}only out for money like before, and all{CLEAR}their prices are affordable now.

strings.en: My friend says she’s going to put on a{NEWLINE}transformation show for us. We’re all{CLEAR}excited! But we’ve been waiting{CLEAR}forever, and she still hasn’t come{CLEAR}downstairs. Could you go hurry her up{CLEAR}for us?

strings.zh: 金黄市可是关东地区的用电大户,{NEWLINE}这里的电力原本是由{CLEAR}10号路的发电厂提供的。{CLEAR}但随着口袋妖怪生物能的普及,{CLEAR}那座污染严重的旧式发电厂就废弃了。
strings.en: Saffron City uses tons of electricity.{NEWLINE}Its power used to come from the Power{CLEAR}Plant on Route 10. But as Pokémon{CLEAR}bioenergy spread, that old, heavily{CLEAR}polluting plant was abandoned.

strings.zh: 我们金黄市的娜姿馆主{NEWLINE}可是非常厉害的,{CLEAR}就我看来绝不亚于那个{CLEAR}号称「最强」的常磐市馆主。
strings.en: Our very own Sabrina, Saffron’s Gym{NEWLINE}Leader, is incredible. In my book, she’s{CLEAR}every bit as good as that so-called{CLEAR}‘strongest’ Gym Leader in Viridian City.

strings.zh: 唉,本以为收集了6枚徽章{NEWLINE}就能轻松拿下金黄道馆的,{CLEAR}没成想我完全抵挡不住{CLEAR}娜姿小姐的超能力。{SCROLL}听说只有意志力强大的训练家,{NEWLINE}才能免受超能力的影响。{CLEAR}看来我需要经历更多的事情{CLEAR}来锻炼自己的意志力才行啊。
strings.en: Sigh... I thought that with six Badges{NEWLINE}I’d waltz through the Saffron Gym.{CLEAR}Turns out I couldn’t stand up to{CLEAR}Sabrina’s psychic powers at all.{SCROLL}They say only Trainers with a strong{NEWLINE}will can resist psychic powers. Looks{CLEAR}like I need more life experience to{CLEAR}toughen up my willpower.

strings.en: Dammit! Thanks to Team Rocket’s cruise{NEWLINE}ship hijacking at Vermilion Harbor,{CLEAR}every route to Johto is shut down. I{CLEAR}can’t get any stock to sell!

I recently learned a really handy{CLEAR}special move, Fire Punch. It’s perfect{CLEAR}for Fire-type Pokémon. If you’d like to{CLEAR}learn it, come see me anytime.

They say these six are{CLEAR}second only to the Elite Four, and{CLEAR}every bit as strong as the Gym Leaders.{SCROLL}The Pokémon League has put these{NEWLINE}six Trainers in charge of building{CLEAR}a Battle Frontier in the Johto region.{CLEAR}With their skill, vision and experience,{CLEAR}they’re sure to build a really{CLEAR}exciting Battle Frontier!

strings.zh: 东北角的那个混元国术馆,{NEWLINE}简直就是一间骗子武馆,{CLEAR}那个馆主马老头{CLEAR}他根本就不懂格斗系精灵。{CLEAR}就我上次找他PK,{CLEAR}我直接就把他的精灵给秒了。{SCROLL}出来混,就应该靠硬实力,{NEWLINE}他那套坑蒙拐骗指定不成的！
strings.en: That Hunyuan Dojo in the northeast{NEWLINE}corner is a total scam. Old man Ma, the{CLEAR}guy who runs it, doesn’t know squat{CLEAR}about Fighting types. Last time I went{CLEAR}to fight him, I one-shot his Pokémon on{CLEAR}the spot.{SCROLL}Out here, you get by on real skill.{NEWLINE}That con-man routine of his ain’t gonna{CLEAR}cut it!

strings.zh: 我在对市里的消防设施检修呢。{NEWLINE}虽然我这样平凡的人{CLEAR}成不了精英训练家,{CLEAR}但至少也能为金黄市的洁净、安全{CLEAR}贡献自己的一份力量。
strings.en: I’m inspecting the city’s fire safety{NEWLINE}equipment. An ordinary guy like me will{CLEAR}never be an Ace Trainer, but I can at{CLEAR}least do my part to keep Saffron City{CLEAR}clean and safe.

strings.zh: 金黄市有很多标志性建筑呢,{NEWLINE}高耸的摩天大楼、飞快的悬浮列车、{CLEAR}并排而立的两座道馆……{CLEAR}真是个建筑物的钢铁森林！
strings.en: Saffron City has so many landmarks.{NEWLINE}Towering skyscrapers, the super-fast{CLEAR}Magnet Train, two Gyms standing side by{CLEAR}side... It’s a real concrete jungle!

strings.zh: 嘿嘿嘿,这里是金黄市,{NEWLINE}整个关东地区的中心城市,{CLEAR}除了是各种物资的汇聚之处外,{CLEAR}也是各路情报信息的汇聚之处。{CLEAR}如果你肯支付一定的费用,{CLEAR}我就可以告诉你一些独家来源的情报。
strings.en: Heh heh heh. This is Saffron City, the{NEWLINE}heart of the whole Kanto region. All{CLEAR}kinds of goods pass through here, and{CLEAR}so does all kinds of information. If{CLEAR}you’re willing to pay a fee, I can tell{CLEAR}you some exclusive intel.

strings.zh: 据说火箭队里有10名干部,{NEWLINE}这10名干部至少都是{CLEAR}道馆馆主级别的强力训练家,{CLEAR}有的甚至是能与四天王比肩的高手。{SCROLL}现在精灵联盟公布的火箭队干部{NEWLINE}有满嘴脏话的伦达、{CLEAR}心狠手辣的水吾桐{CLEAR}以及狡猾阴险的赤焰松。{CLEAR}另外7名还没有浮出水面的干部嘛,{CLEAR}据我所知有一位是藏身在彩虹市的。
strings.en: They say Team Rocket has ten{NEWLINE}Executives. Every one of them is a{CLEAR}strong Trainer at least on par with a{CLEAR}Gym Leader, and some are experts who{CLEAR}rival the Elite Four.{SCROLL}So far, the Pokémon League has named{NEWLINE}the foul-mouthed Petrel, the ruthless{CLEAR}Archie and the cunning, treacherous{CLEAR}Maxie. As for the other seven still in{CLEAR}hiding... from what I know, one of them{CLEAR}is lying low in Celadon City.

strings.zh: 火箭队这个组织其实早就建立了,{NEWLINE}只不过过去一直是暗中活动,{CLEAR}最近一年才开始浮上台面{CLEAR}出现在大众视野里。{SCROLL}能让10名强大的火箭队干部{NEWLINE}俯首称臣的那位首领,{CLEAR}在整个地区应该也是屈指可数,{CLEAR}所以很多人猜测{CLEAR}火箭队的首领就在精灵联盟内部。
strings.en: Team Rocket was actually founded long{NEWLINE}ago. It just operated in secret, and{CLEAR}only surfaced into public view in the{CLEAR}last year.{SCROLL}A boss who can make ten powerful{NEWLINE}Executives bow down must be one of the{CLEAR}very few in the region who could. So a{CLEAR}lot of people suspect that Team{CLEAR}Rocket’s boss is inside the{CLEAR}Pokémon League itself.

strings.zh: 精灵联盟为了践行{NEWLINE}「造福更多人」的理念,{CLEAR}正在对各个领域进行改革。{CLEAR}有为了防止资源滥用的所有制改革,{CLEAR}有为了防止拢断的经济改革,{CLEAR}有为了促进公平竞争的制度改革等等。{SCROLL}不过这样一连串激进的改革,{NEWLINE}也确实得罪了不少既得利益群体呢。
strings.en: To live up to its motto, ‘Benefit more{NEWLINE}people,’ the Pokémon League is{CLEAR}reforming every field. There’s{CLEAR}ownership reform to prevent resource{CLEAR}abuse, economic reform to prevent{CLEAR}monopolies, system reform to promote{CLEAR}fair competition, and so on.{SCROLL}But this string of radical{NEWLINE}reforms has also stepped{CLEAR}on a lot of vested interests.

strings.zh: 我本来想跟混元国术馆的马老师{NEWLINE}学一下格斗系精灵的用法,{CLEAR}但是来到金黄市之后{CLEAR}听到有人说马老师是个骗子,{CLEAR}弄得我就很犹豫{CLEAR}到底要不要去跟他学习呢。
strings.en: I wanted to learn how to use Fighting{NEWLINE}types from Master Ma at the Hunyuan{CLEAR}Dojo. But after I got to Saffron City, I{CLEAR}heard people say Master Ma is a fraud,{CLEAR}and now I can’t decide whether to study{CLEAR}with him or not.

strings.zh: 在火箭队袭击金黄市的时候,{NEWLINE}我算是看明白了,{CLEAR}马老师的格斗系精灵用的果然很外行。{SCROLL}但是他面对暴徒时{NEWLINE}能挺身而出、保卫家园,{CLEAR}这份勇敢正义的精神,{CLEAR}就值得我向称他一声老师。
strings.en: When Team Rocket attacked Saffron{NEWLINE}City, I saw it with my own eyes. Master{CLEAR}Ma really does use Fighting types like{CLEAR}an amateur.{SCROLL}But he stood up to those thugs to{NEWLINE}protect our home. That brave,{CLEAR}righteous spirit alone earns him the{CLEAR}title of ‘Master’ from me.

strings.zh: 北边华蓝市的海角{NEWLINE}是情侣的约会圣地,{CLEAR}你说我如果约娜姿小姐一起去的话{CLEAR}她会答应吗？

strings.zh: 多亏精灵联盟结束了{NEWLINE}城市自治的混乱时代,{CLEAR}把地区的发展引到了人与自然、{CLEAR}与口袋妖怪和谐相处的正路上来。{SCROLL}如果由残暴的火箭队统治世界,{NEWLINE}恐怕大多数人和精灵就要遭罪了。
strings.en: Thank goodness the Pokémon League{NEWLINE}ended the chaotic era of city self-rule{CLEAR}and set the region on the right path,{CLEAR}where people live in harmony with nature{CLEAR}and Pokémon.{SCROLL}If brutal Team Rocket ruled the world,{NEWLINE}most people and Pokémon would suffer.

strings.zh: 你不增强作为训练家的意志力,{NEWLINE}是永远战胜不了娜姿小姐的。

strings.zh: 你很行嘛,{NEWLINE}看来你的意志力要比我强不少。{CLEAR}这个技能机送给你吧,{CLEAR}希望能在你挑战娜姿小姐的时候{CLEAR}有所帮助。

strings.zh: 每次跟你特训完我{NEWLINE}都感觉我的意志力都有所成长,{CLEAR}随时欢迎你再来找我训练。

strings.zh: 哇,你已经从娜姿小姐那里{NEWLINE}拿到了金色徽章！{CLEAR}你真是太厉害了！
strings.en: Wow, you got the Marsh Badge from{NEWLINE}Sabrina! You’re amazing!

strings.zh: 你好,这里是全国最大的制造业公司{NEWLINE}西鲁夫公司的总部大楼。

strings.zh: 你好,这里是精灵联盟下属的{NEWLINE}西鲁夫公司总部大楼。
strings.en: Hello! This is the headquarters of Silph{NEWLINE}Co., a subsidiary of the{CLEAR}Pokémon League.

strings.zh: 你真是太厉害了,{NEWLINE}连全力应战的娜姿小姐都可以打败。{SCROLL}那么我这个特殊的超能力招式{NEWLINE}意念头槌你一定也可以轻松掌握,{CLEAR}只要你能给我1个抗恶果,{CLEAR}我就可以把意念头槌教给你的精灵。{SCROLL}怎么样,要学吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: You’re amazing! You even beat Sabrina{NEWLINE}when she fought at full strength.{SCROLL}Then you’ll master my special psychic{NEWLINE}move, Zen Headbutt, with ease. Just{CLEAR}give me one Colbur Berry and I’ll teach{CLEAR}it to your Pokémon.{SCROLL}So, want to learn it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 哇,我的朋友好厉害,{NEWLINE}居然可以这么唯妙唯肖地{CLEAR}模仿娜姿小姐！
strings.en: Wow, my friend is amazing! She can{NEWLINE}imitate Sabrina so perfectly!

strings.zh: 我有一个朋友就住在{NEWLINE}前面这栋粉色的房子里,{CLEAR}我们约好了来这里看她的变身表演,{CLEAR}结果等了好久她都没有下楼,{CLEAR}她到底在忙什么呢？
strings.en: A friend of mine lives in this pink house{NEWLINE}up ahead. We agreed to come watch her{CLEAR}transformation show, but we’ve waited{CLEAR}forever and she still hasn’t come down.{CLEAR}What is she doing up there?

strings.zh: 简直难以置信,{NEWLINE}我朋友变装成娜姿小姐时{CLEAR}看我的那个眼神,{CLEAR}简直就跟真正的娜姿小姐一模一样！
strings.en: I can’t believe it! When my friend{NEWLINE}dressed up as Sabrina,{CLEAR}the look she gave me was{CLEAR}exactly like the real Sabrina’s!

strings.zh: 什么？有个小姑娘想学变身表演,{NEWLINE}问我能不能过去教教她？{CLEAR}可以是可以啦,{CLEAR}但是我是靠魔术表演吃饭的,{CLEAR}可不能白教学生,{CLEAR}如果想请我当老师的话{CLEAR}你总得表示表示吧？{CLEAR}这样吧,你如果能帮我找一把{CLEAR}魔术表演用的弯勺来,{CLEAR}我就可以考虑去教教那位小姑娘。
strings.en: What? A little girl wants to learn how to{NEWLINE}do a transformation show, and she’s{CLEAR}asking if I can come teach her? I could,{CLEAR}sure. But I make my living doing magic{CLEAR}shows. I can’t teach students for{CLEAR}free. If you want me as her teacher,{CLEAR}you’ll have to show some appreciation,{CLEAR}won’t you? Tell you what. Find me a{CLEAR}Twisted Spoon for my magic act, and I’ll{CLEAR}think about teaching the little girl.

strings.zh: 哦？你这不是带着弯勺吗？{NEWLINE}要把弯勺给我吗？
strings.en: Oh? Isn’t that a Twisted Spoon you’ve{NEWLINE}got there? Will you give it to me?

strings.zh: 没有弯勺的话,{NEWLINE}我是不会去教学的。
strings.en: No Twisted Spoon, no lessons.

strings.zh: 真是太好了,{NEWLINE}你的弯勺我收下了。{CLEAR}我这就去那个小姑娘家看看。
strings.en: Wonderful! I’ll take the Twisted Spoon.{NEWLINE}I’ll go see that little girl right away.
